requiredIdeas: Every home device gets a private address from a reserved range.
The subnet says which addresses are local neighbors. On the same subnet, devices can reach each other directly.
The router does three jobs: gateway to the internet, handing out addresses (DHCP), and sharing one public address among everyone (NAT).
How to find your own address, subnet, and gateway on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
